input: Attend a live improv comedy show tonight

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Improv shows are location-dependent — knowing the city or neighborhood determines which venues and shows are even options.
Budget affects whether the user targets free community shows, low-cost indie nights, or ticketed professional venues.
How the user plans to get there (car, transit, ride-share) affects how far away a venue can realistically be.
Improv ranges from short-form games (like Whose Line) to long-form Harold sets — the preferred format shapes which shows to target.
Going solo vs. with a group affects ticket logistics, seating preferences, and possibly whether a reservation is needed.
A specific time window (e.g., must be done by midnight, can't leave until 8 PM) narrows which show start times are viable.
Knowing what a great night looks like — a guaranteed laugh, discovering new local talent, a specific venue vibe — helps prioritize among options.
